description: Use this when the person asks which supplier declarations on preferential origin are valid, missing or running out in their own account. Lists supplier × article of the connected account with the status of the supplier’s declaration on preferential origin (valid, expiring, expired, missing, revoked, to be checked, refused, single shipment, no preferential origin), its end of validity and the agreements it names, plus how many articles have no valid declaration. It reads only: requesting, reminding, checking and issuing declarations is done in the dashboard, and the tool returns that link. It never judges whether goods have origin. Do not use to decide whether goods have preferential origin, or to request, remind or issue a declaration; that is done in the dashboard.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_supplier_declarations
title: Supplier declarations (preferential origin)
